notes.title: Let's Play Villagedom
notes.content:

[h1]Join us as Alex from Crytivo becomes King![/h1]

[h2]About[/h2]
How good are you of a King? Villagedom is a city-builder / resource management game that will force you to make tough decisions about the development of your kingdom. Grow from a small village to a powerful Kingdom. Protect your citizens and slay your enemies. Be the King!
